title: Structure Diff and Mapping Blueprint
description: Output format for the deterministic Schema Diff Engine

sourceSchemaId.description: Identifier of the source system (System A) schema

targetSchemaId.description: Identifier of the target system (System B) schema

hasDifferences.description: True if structural or type differences were found

addedFields.description: Paths of fields present in target but not in source

removedFields.description: Paths of fields present in source but not in target

typeChanges.description: Fields that have different data types

items.description: Transformation rules (JSONLogic or similar deterministic format) to resolve the mismatch

blueprint.description: Proposed transformation rules to bridge the schemas

requiresLLMFallback.description: True if deterministic rules could not resolve the differences and LLM fallback is needed
